question: Should OpenClaw accept the legacy Installed Apps opt-in reset and ship this Google Play disclosure/Data Safety rollout once the branch is refreshed?
rationale: The patch is focused and privacy-protective, but resetting shipped opt-ins and adding a Play Console mutation lane are upgrade and release-policy choices that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept reset and rollout
options.body: Approve the consent-version reset, verify the Play Console/Data Safety materials, refresh the branch, and land the PR.

options.title: Revise disclosure first
options.body: Request wording, placement, consent-version, or release-lane changes if Play review or product policy needs a different disclosure shape.

options.title: Hold for release materials
options.body: Keep the PR open until Data Safety CSV, Play Console state, privacy policy, and review artifacts are ready to ship together.

recommendation.title: Accept reset and rollout
recommendation.body: Approve the consent-version reset, verify the Play Console/Data Safety materials, refresh the branch, and land the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android settings and Android release-workflow history make this the best available owner for the conflict refresh and rollout decision.
